statement.p: Find the vertices, foci, axes, center (if an ellipse or a hyperbola) and asymptotes (if a hyperbola) of the conic section x^2+8 y^2 = 64

The conic section is
An ellipse
A Parabola
A hyperbola

The focal axis and the conjugate axis are
y=8 and x=64 respectively.
x=0 and y=0 respectively.
x=64 and y=8 respectively.
y=0 and x=0 respectively.

The conic section's center is at
(0,0)
(1,1)
(8,8)
(8,64)
(-8,-8)

static.solution:
64 to convert it to the equation in standard form: \frac{{x}^{2}}{64}+\frac{8 {y}^{2}}{64}=1 \Rightarrow \frac{{x}^{2}}{64}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{8}=1 \Rightarrow {\left(\frac{x}{8}\right)}^{2}+{\left(\frac{y}{\sqrt{8}}\right)}^{2}=1 For this ellipse, a=8 and b=\sqrt{8} hence c=\sqrt{{8}^{2}-\left(\sqrt{8}\right)^2}=\sqrt{56}.
Since a>b we have:
\bullet The vertices are at \left(\pm 8, 0\right),\left(0, \pm \sqrt{8}\right).
\bullet The foci are {F}_{1}=\left(-\sqrt{56}, 0\right) and {F}_{2}=\left(\sqrt{56}, 0\right).
\bullet The focal axis is the x-axis and the conjugate axis is the y-axis.
\bullet The ellipse is centered at the origin.
